subject: Customer: Missing output chunks reported — investigation and closure
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@archscale.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Missing chunks in model responses (example attached)

Hi Hannah,

We've been seeing sporadic responses from Redwood where the model returns truncated/partial text — missing the last 20-40 tokens — across a handful of requests yesterday. I attached a sample request/response and our request id. This started around 08:40 PDT and affected ~7 out of 200 requests for our batch job.

Can you check if there's any ongoing degradation or if we did something wrong on our side?

Thanks,
Liam
ArchScale — Platform Engineering

Attachment: archscale_sample_response.json (application/json, 2KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@archscale.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missing chunks in model responses (example attached)

Hi Liam — thanks for the sample and the heads up. We're looking into this now.

Quick notes: can you confirm whether these requests were using streaming responses or full-response mode? Also, if you have any request IDs or timestamps beyond the sample, please attach them; they help us correlate with router logs.

I'll loop in Diego and Marcus to run an initial triage.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Hannah Schmitt
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Missing chunks in model responses — triage notes

Hannah/Marcus — quick summary from my repro attempts overnight:

- Replayed ArchScale's sample request across our staging and production clusters (same model and sequence length). No truncation observed in ~1500 replayed requests.
- Checked router + runtime logs for the provided request IDs (cross-referenced with Liam's timestamps). No error or early EOF in transport layer; responses completed with full token count.
- Spot-checked GPU logs for OOMs and kernel timeouts — none around the reported window.

I attached the replay run logs and the small script I used. My working hypothesis: intermittent client-side network interruption or a downstream proxy that cut the stream on ArchScale's side.

I'll keep monitoring production metrics for any recurrence, but at this point I can't reproduce and logs show normal completion.

Attachment: repro-run-20260821.txt (text/plain, 18KB); redwood_request_logs_20260820.gz (application/gzip, 1.6MB)

Regards,
Diego
Platform Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missing chunks in model responses — quick verification

Confirming Diego's findings. I pulled token-level counts and our delivery ACKs for the sample requests — the backend shows full token generation and successful TCP-level delivery to the edge. There are a few transient spikes in per-edge latency around 08:30–09:00 PDT, but not correlated with truncated outputs in our traces.

Action items I recommend:
- Hannah, ask ArchScale whether they route traffic through any intermediate proxies/load balancers that might have short timeouts for streaming connections.
- We'll keep a 72-hour elevated watch on the model's streaming delivery metrics for ArchScale's org id.

If we don't see a repeat, propose closing the ticket with guidance for the customer to check their network path.

-Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@archscale.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missing chunks in model responses (example attached) — investigation closed

Hi Liam — quick update from our investigation:

Summary:
- We replayed your sample and 1.5k additional requests against prod and staging; all completed with full token output.
- Our runtime and edge logs for the referenced timeframe show successful token generation and delivery; no runtime OOMs or early terminations were observed.
- We observed short-lived edge latency spikes in the 08:30–09:00 PDT window but no evidence indicating the service truncated responses.

Conclusion and recommended next steps:
- At this time we cannot reproduce the missing-chunks behavior on Redwood's side and have no evidence of a backend issue. The most likely causes are intermittent network interruptions or a client-side proxy/load balancer that terminates streams early.
- Please check any intermediate proxies (timeouts, connection limits) and your client HTTP library's streaming handling. If you can capture a packet-level trace or proxy logs for an affected request, we can re-open and dive deeper.

We'll keep elevated monitoring for 72 hours and will reach out immediately if we detect recurrence. Closing this thread for now, but please reopen with additional artifacts and we'll prioritize.

Appreciate you flagging this — sorry for the disruption.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_request_logs_20260820.gz, repro-run-20260821.txt
